game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes, dunes at sunset: the desert nomad must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Validation Fortress: Write input checks that reject bad data so dust devils can't sneak through.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes: dunes at sunset
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunset Dunes, repeat each round: Write input checks that reject bad data so dust devils can't sneak through. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the fortress value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the supply tent using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The supply tent reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the supply tent is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Validation Fortress
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Validation Fortress' (Week 9 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sunset Dunes'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fortress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Sunset Dunes.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The supply tent reached with actions_used <= 16.
